nodes.label: STMX Vision Extraction Schema FROZEN V1
nodes.rationale: Sole active Source of Truth for the Vision Extraction Schema; frozen by ADR-120 (2026-08-08) and changed only via Controlled Amendment.

nodes.label: Controlled Amendment Process
nodes.rationale: Changes only via Validation Evidence -> Issue Report -> CEO Review -> Amendment; historical amendments preserved verbatim (no in-place rewrite) to keep provenance.

nodes.label: Four-State Observation Model
nodes.rationale: OBSERVED / ABSENT / NOT_VISIBLE / UNKNOWN with semantic None kept structurally distinct so absence, invisibility and indeterminacy are never collapsed.

nodes.label: State/Value Invariant (CA#24)
nodes.rationale: Non-OBSERVED states force value=null; validator-enforced (NON_OBSERVED_VALUE_PRESENT, MULTI_SCALAR_VALUE_PRESENT, MULTI_NON_OBSERVED_VALUES).

nodes.label: SV-5 Semantic None Enforcement (CA#37)
nodes.rationale: For the 11 parameters with None in domain, visible+absent must be OBSERVED/None; ABSENT illegal there; new mirror error SEMANTIC_NONE_REQUIRED; validation is not correction.

nodes.label: MULTI Canonical Consumption Contract
nodes.rationale: MULTI (material, surface, decorative_detail, attachment, exposure_opening) carried only in values[]; scalar .value is always null to avoid dual canonical representation and implied dominance.

nodes.label: MULTI Serialization Alignment (CA#25)
nodes.rationale: Root cause was ambiguous single OUTPUT SHAPE template causing stochastic drift (4%-64%); fixed in order authority -> prompt -> tests -> validator.

nodes.label: D-4 Location Contract
nodes.rationale: Optional per-value locations[] metadata (component + descriptor Panel/Edge) for material/surface/decorative_detail/attachment; region, component, descriptor and evidence are four non-substitutable layers.

nodes.label: Category UNKNOWN Applicability Routing
nodes.rationale: applicability_status RESOLVED|UNRESOLVED_CATEGORY separates NOT APPLICABLE from APPLICABILITY UNRESOLVED; GROUP A extracted, GROUP B (silhouette/fit/length) omitted until category known.

nodes.label: Four-Way Applicability Separation
nodes.rationale: NOT APPLICABLE vs APPLICABILITY UNRESOLVED vs NOT_VISIBLE vs UNKNOWN must not be mixed.

nodes.label: Canonical Parameter Inventory
nodes.rationale: Frozen-40 -> 35 (CA#15) -> 36 (sleeve_volume PN36) -> 37 production (collar_scale); operative ground truth = producer_rules_v1.js.

nodes.label: shoulder_drop Canonical Definition (CA#38)
nodes.rationale: Final discriminator is preservation of the normal anatomical shoulder endpoint, not junction position; Extended/Oversized/outboard junction alone are not Dropped.

nodes.label: Semantic Authority vs Model Performance Layers
nodes.rationale: Layer A (definition) is closed; Layer B (Vision perception) failures do not automatically reopen the definition.

nodes.label: shoulder_structure Visual Morphology Recalibration (CA#32)
nodes.rationale: Judge only visible outer contour; inferred padding/built structure prohibited because 90% of evidence strings were padding inference driven by the prompt.

nodes.label: sleeve_volume Regular/Voluminous (CA#30)
nodes.rationale: Intensity grading retired (Exaggerated never emitted); binary morphology; no automatic puffer rule.

nodes.label: pockets[] Single Carrier (CA#29)
nodes.rationale: Scalar fallback MODE B was never used live (0/35), so pockets[] is the sole canonical pocket morphology carrier.

nodes.label: Pocket Morphology Completeness (CA#28)
nodes.rationale: pocket=Present requires a morphology response; 31% of runs lacked any carrier and validator detected none.

nodes.label: waist_definition Trigger Ownership (CA#27)
nodes.rationale: Self-referencing controller trigger made omissions invisible; applicability is now category-gate only and readability is expressed by the 4-state model.

nodes.label: Jacket Length Semantic Boundary (CA#22)
nodes.rationale: Waist Zone ~±10cm body-relative; pocket coverage is primary Waist/Hip discriminator; construction features banned as length proxies.

nodes.label: Body-less Length Hard Gate (CA#34)
nodes.rationale: Without a wearer, body-relative length is NOT_VISIBLE; garment visibility is not body-landmark visibility.

nodes.label: Piping decorative_detail (CA#19)
nodes.rationale: Feature, location and colour are three separate contracts (Producer garment, D-4, Colour V1).

nodes.label: read_organiser R1 (CA#39)
nodes.rationale: Added as PN38 but superseded by CA#40: it is a derived dominance judgment, not lawful raw observation under the Observation Constitution.

nodes.label: SA-1 construction_referent_evidence (CA#40)
nodes.rationale: Reuses existing primitives relative_size/contrast/spatial_position on 4 construction referents; firewall forbids prominence/dominance/score emission.

nodes.label: STMX_VISION_PRODUCER_V1_3
nodes.rationale: Production Vision producer (37 parameters); pointer unchanged by CA#39/CA#40.

nodes.label: Guard G40
nodes.rationale: Vision does not discard visually observable evidence because downstream does not consume it; observation applicability ⊇ consumption scope.

nodes.label: Controller Firewall
nodes.rationale: Controller only preserves/trims structurally; never infers location, value or morphology from semantics (no guessing).

nodes.label: Non-Inference Rules
nodes.rationale: No product/brand name, hidden construction, fiber certainty or score/axis leakage inference.
